unresolved_before_permit.reason: The engine assigns child to job after CreateProcessW; abrupt parent crash in this short gap might strand a suspended child before it is assigned. Source-only checks cannot prove fail-safe containment. Consider creation-time PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST (supported on Win10+) or equivalent independently reviewed recovery, while preserving approved architecture boundaries.
8KiB is enforced by polling/at-rest check, not a hard OS quota; a fast child may temporarily exceed it before 100ms poll. Limit output/disk and demonstrate bounded failure before real run.
Executable SHA-256 is verified by path before CreateProcessW, leaving a TOCTOU gap on writable filesystem. Require immutable staged binary/ACL pin or equivalent assurance.
Win32 PInvoke structures/marshaling and 64-bit STARTUPINFOEX behavior must be independently inspected and later compiler/runtime qualified before permit.
There is intentionally no Main, no permit verifier, no one-shot marker consumer, and no source-pinned executable watchdog. These are mandatory before run.
